# Clea

> Clea (clea.no) is a Norwegian fashion and beauty price-comparison site with an AI shopping assistant. It brings together more than 1 000 000 products from 15+ online stores, shows the same product's price across stores, and links shoppers directly to the store to buy. Prices are in Norwegian kroner (NOK). The site is in Norwegian.

Clea er en norsk tjeneste for prissammenligning av mote og skjønnhet, med en AI-moteassistent. Søk med vanlige ord ("vinterjakke dame under 2000 kr"), sammenlign prisen på samme vare hos flere butikker, og få varsel når prisen faller.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.clea.no/): search across all stores and see popular products
- [Shop by category](https://www.clea.no/shop): dresses, tops, knitwear, trousers and jeans, jackets, shoes, bags, accessories, beauty
- [Stores](https://www.clea.no/brands): every partner store and its products
- [AI chat](https://www.clea.no/chat): describe what you need and get product suggestions
- [About Clea](https://www.clea.no/about)
- [FAQ](https://www.clea.no/faq)
- [For partners and stores](https://www.clea.no/partner)
- [Contact](https://www.clea.no/contact)

## Product pages

Each product has a page at https://www.clea.no/product/{id} with its price, the stores that sell it, similar products and a price-drop alert.
